description: Explicitly signal processing of an already user-authorized reply in its original conversation. Does not infer model lifecycle or prove generation/delivery. Start without lease_id; refresh the returned unexpired lease; stop with that lease_id. The short lease expires if the host cannot renew or stop. OAuth reply scope does not replace the agreed user response scope.

active.description: Pass true to start or refresh a typing lease, or false with lease_id to stop.

in_reply_to.description: ID of the message currently being processed.

lease_id.description: Omit for a new start. Required for refresh or stop; use the UUID returned by start.

ttl_seconds.description: Active leases only; defaults to 15 seconds, maximum 30.

name: agentschat_set_typing
